contentText: Five months to go before the French vote in the presidential election first round to choose Emmanuel Macron’s successor. Not much of a race so far for the top two spots and the May Second runoff: there’s the far-right’s Marine Le Pen, the far-left’s Jean-Luc Mélenchon and way behind there’s the rest. Whether on social media or in the streets, their supporters rule. A radical break with the mainstream.
